visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tier or plan comparison table showing which benefits each tier includes
visualCharacteristics.layout: header row of tier names; body rows with a sticky benefit label column and tick/cross icons per tier; scrolls horizontally on narrow screens

contentPattern.structure: First row: empty cell then column names (e.g. Bronze | Silver | Gold | Platinum). Following rows: benefit label then one cell per column containing Included or Excluded (other text is shown as-is)

reuseGuidance: Use for feature/benefit matrices across plans or tiers. Write Included/Excluded (or Yes/No) to get icons.
